Specification: This module specifies a small test of deserializing a set of strings from disk using IOUtils and TLC. It defines a partial set of two known string elements, reads a serialized set twice from the same file name obtained through TLCGet, unions the partial set with both deserialized results, and asserts assumptions about the reconstructed set. The assumptions check that the union has cardinality 5, that the known partial set is contained in each deserialized set, and that the two deserializations are equal, effectively testing determinism and absence of duplicate-string corruption during deserialization.
StringLiterals: Omnis iusto nisi molestiae consequuntur. Eos ipsum dignissimos rem magnam. Sed nihil amet doloribus facere sequi. Magni omnis voluptatem nam soluta voluptatibus et debitis.
Sunt quas veritatis atque facilis. Vitae qui voluptatibus aut odio. Sequi minima amet ad eum voluptatem vel. Libero maiores aut iusto molestiae accusamus aut ex nihil.
